admissionInfo.text: Application for admission to the program. Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Information Systems, Information Security, Information Technology, or Computer Science. 2 years of IT or IT security industry experience (if Bachelor's degree in non-related field). Completion of undergraduate courses in data communication, programming and servers.
